import subprocess, re, os
bin='/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/meson/fuzzing/fuzz_variant_binary_byteswap'
types=[b'(ssn)',b'(sns)',b'(nss)',b'(sn)',b'(ns)',b'(s)',b'(as n)'.replace(b' ',b''),b'(ssq)',b'(qqn)']
for t in types:
  print('TYPE',t)
  for L in [0,1,2,3,4,5,10,100,250,251,252,253,254,255,256,257,258,300]:
    p=f'/tmp/testpoc'
    open(p,'wb').write(b'A'*L + b'\x00'+t)
    try:
      r=subprocess.run([bin,p],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=2)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
      print(' L',L,'timeout'); continue
    out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
    m=re.search(r'READ of size (\d+)',out)
    if r.returncode:
      print(' L',L,'ret',r.returncode,'read',m.group(1) if m else None, (re.search(r'gvariant[^\n]*:(\d+)', out) or re.search(r'#\d+ .*', out)).group(0) if (re.search(r'gvariant[^\n]*:(\d+)', out) or re.search(r'#\d+ .*', out)) else '')
  print()
